name: scenario-to-desktop.evidence-inventory
purpose: Summarize retained desktop capture metadata and cross-check producer counts, returning five evidence references without reading media or granting readiness.
assumptions: The caller uses the declared scenario bindings and preserves unavailable evidence.
Program success describes the read; it never grants deployment approval.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.
Read-only: no launch, build, publication, recovery, inference, delegation, or memory write.
Return identifiers and bounded projections; never print logs, configuration, credentials, media bytes, or private endpoints.
Capture count never establishes freshness, useful video, checksum verification, matrix completeness, or release approval.

signals.capture_count: Count from the metadata list; null if the read failed.
signals.summary_count: Independent producer count; null if unreadable.
signals.total_bytes: Producer-reported retained bytes; not a bundle-size performance measure.
signals.by_kind: Distribution of retained capture kinds, at most ten kinds.
signals.incomplete_metadata: Count missing identity, checksum, session, or timestamp; not a validity verdict.
signals.captures: Five newest metadata references; historical and not candidate-artifact scoped.
signals.truncated: True when the returned sample omits other captures.

outputs.evidence: Successfully read binding IDs; selected pipeline or capture identities are in signals.

fixtures.note: Read-only reference inventory. Empty inventory is an honest zero, not a desktop pass.
